payload.reason: The evidence provides information about human evaluation results for text generation tasks, specifically in the context of summarization models evaluated on various datasets.

claims.text: Human evaluation results for extracted summaries are demonstrated in Appendix A.6, indicating the superiority of the proposed system over baselines.
The evaluation of summarization models includes comparisons with ORACLE summaries, which serve as a benchmark for assessing the quality of generated summaries.
The results of the human evaluation are intended to provide an intuitive understanding of the model's performance compared to baseline systems.
